Select IC50 activity records for erdafitinib and its salt forms against fibroblast growth factor receptor 2. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL3545376 to include all related forms. Retrieve activity provenance through the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Filter for target CHEMBL4142 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
